title: The Efficiency Gap
visual_prompt: A modern, minimalist flat-design infographic on a clean white background. Two circular 'Context Windows' are shown side-by-side. Left: 'Standard AI' - filled with a chaotic, pixelated mess of red and grey blocks (representing 100k+ junk tokens), labeled 'Context Bloat'. Right: 'C3 Intelligence' - contains only a few sharp, glowing blue 'data gems' (representing surgical 2k tokens), labeled 'Surgical Precision'. A large arrow between them shows '-98% Token Waste'. Ultra-clean vector style, professional typography.
typography_style: Geometric Sans-Serif (Inter/Roboto style), bold headings, light body text.
layout_description: Horizontal comparison layout with centralized stats and a clear 'Value Proposition' footer.
